role: development pilot for state-aware routing on real dependent nodes from one complex financial task

dag.true_dependency: Each node after N1 receives the actual upstream output; N4 must produce the final answer from N3 and cited evidence, not independently answer the original task.

metrics.quality: semantic score of N4 final answer against isolated reference answer
metrics.cost: sum of all executed node call costs
metrics.latency: critical-path sum for this sequential DAG

gates.state_information: paired task-bootstrap 95% CI lower bound of state-aware minus request-only score > 0
gates.dag_routing: state-aware minus static is significantly positive for at least one core objective
gates.adaptive: deferred to E4.1; completion gain must be reported with cost and latency deltas

reference_policy: Reference answers are evaluator-only and are excluded from DAG manifests, prompts, router features, and runtime state.
